```{r loading results, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(ggplot2)

study_data_path <- c("../data/studyData.RData", "data/studyData.RData")
study_data_path <- study_data_path[file.exists(study_data_path)][1]

if (is.na(study_data_path)) {
  stop("Could not find `studyData.RData` in `../data/` or `data/`.")
}

load(study_data_path)

all_results <- data |>
  purrr::keep(~ inherits(.x, "data.frame")) |>
  bind_rows()

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  c(
    "result_id", "cdm_name", "group_level", "variable_name",
    "variable_level", "estimate_name", "estimate_value", "strata_name"
  ),
  names(all_results)
)

if (length(missing_columns)) {
  stop(
    "Loaded study data is missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

survival_curve_result_ids <- all_results |>
  filter(variable_name == "outcome", estimate_name == "estimate") |>
  distinct(result_id) |>
  pull(result_id)

survival_summary_result_ids <- all_results |>
  filter(
    variable_name == "outcome",
    estimate_name %in% c(
      "median_survival",
      "restricted_mean_survival",
      "number_records_count",
      "n_events_count"
    )
  ) |>
  distinct(result_id) |>
  pull(result_id)

# Helper function to process survival curves with dynamic column renaming
process_survival_curves <- function(data, strata_filter = "overall") {
  raw_data <- data |>
    filter(
      result_id %in% survival_curve_result_ids,
      variable_name == "outcome",
      grepl("estimate", estimate_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
      if(strata_filter == "overall") strata_name == "overall" else grepl(strata_filter, strata_name)
    ) |>
    select(cdm_name, group_level, variable_level, any_of("strata_level"), 
           estimate_name, estimate_value, additional_level) |>
    mutate(time = as.numeric(additional_level),
           estimate_value = as.numeric(estimate_value)) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = estimate_name, values_from = estimate_value, values_fn = first)
  
  # Dynamic column renaming - build named vector for rename
  cols <- names(raw_data)
  result <- raw_data |> rename(target_cohort = group_level, outcome = variable_level)
  
  # Rename survival probability column
  if("estimate" %in% cols) {
    result <- result |> rename(survival_prob = estimate)
  } else if(any(grepl("^estimate$|survival.*estimate", cols, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
    est_col <- cols[grepl("^estimate$|survival.*estimate", cols, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
    result <- result |> rename(survival_prob = all_of(est_col))
  }
  
  # Rename CI lower column
  if("estimate_95CI_lower" %in% cols) {
    result <- result |> rename(ci_lower = estimate_95CI_lower)
  } else if(any(grepl("lower|min", cols, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
    ci_col <- cols[grepl("lower|min", cols, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
    result <- result |> rename(ci_lower = all_of(ci_col))
  }
  
  # Rename CI upper column
  if("estimate_95CI_upper" %in% cols) {
    result <- result |> rename(ci_upper = estimate_95CI_upper)
  } else if(any(grepl("upper|max", cols, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
    ci_col <- cols[grepl("upper|max", cols, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
    result <- result |> rename(ci_upper = all_of(ci_col))
  }
  
  result
}

# Helper function to format cohort labels
format_cohort_labels <- function(cohort) {
  case_when(
    cohort == "aortic_insufficiency_congenital" ~ "Aortic Insufficiency",
    cohort == "aortic_stenosis_congenital" ~ "Aortic Stenosis",
    cohort == "congenital_aortic_stenosis" ~ "Congenital Aortic Stenosis",
    cohort == "congenital_aortic_valve_disease" ~ "Congenital Aortic Valve Disease",
    TRUE ~ gsub("_", " ", cohort) |> tools::toTitleCase()
  )
}

format_outcome_labels <- function(outcome) {
  case_when(
    outcome == "ross_procedure" ~ "Ross procedure",
    outcome == "surgical_valvotomy" ~ "Surgical valvotomy",
    outcome == "percutaneous_valvotomy" ~ "Percutaneous valvotomy",
    outcome == "aortic_valve_replacement" ~ "Aortic valve replacement",
    outcome == "death" ~ "Death",
    TRUE ~ gsub("_", " ", outcome) |> tools::toTitleCase()
  )
}

# Prepare survival summary table
survival_table_raw <- all_results |>
  filter(result_id %in% survival_summary_result_ids, variable_name == "outcome", strata_name == "overall") |>
  select(cdm_name, group_level, variable_level, estimate_name, estimate_value) |>
  mutate(estimate_value = as.numeric(estimate_value)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = estimate_name, values_from = estimate_value, values_fn = first)

table_cols <- names(survival_table_raw)
survival_table <- survival_table_raw |>
  mutate(
    median_survival_formatted = if("median_survival" %in% table_cols && 
                                     all(c("median_survival_95CI_lower", "median_survival_95CI_higher") %in% table_cols)) {
      ifelse(is.na(median_survival), "–", 
             sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", median_survival, median_survival_95CI_lower, median_survival_95CI_higher))
    } else "–",
    restricted_mean_survival_formatted = if(all(c("restricted_mean_survival", "restricted_mean_survival_95CI_lower", 
                                                   "restricted_mean_survival_95CI_upper") %in% table_cols)) {
      sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", restricted_mean_survival, restricted_mean_survival_95CI_lower, restricted_mean_survival_95CI_upper)
    } else NA_character_
  ) |>
  select(`CDM name` = cdm_name, `Target cohort` = group_level, `Outcome name` = variable_level,
         any_of(c("Number records" = "number_records_count", "Number events" = "n_events_count")),
         `Median survival (95% CI)` = median_survival_formatted,
         `Restricted mean survival (95% CI)` = restricted_mean_survival_formatted) |>
  arrange(`CDM name`, `Target cohort`, `Outcome name`)

baseline_age_distribution <- all_results |>
  filter(
    result_id == 6,
    variable_name == "Number subjects",
    strata_name == "age_group &&& sex",
    estimate_name == "count"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    cdm_name,
    target_cohort = group_level,
    strata_level,
    n = as.numeric(estimate_value),
    age_group = trimws(sub(" &&&.*$", "", strata_level)),
    sex = trimws(sub("^.*&&&\\s*", "", strata_level))
  ) |>
  group_by(cdm_name, target_cohort) |>
  mutate(total_n = sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    cohort_label = format_cohort_labels(target_cohort),
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("0 to 1", "2 to 12", "13 to 17", "0 to 4", "5 to 9", "10 to 14", "15 to 17")),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )

# Prepare survival curves for different stratifications
survival_curves <- process_survival_curves(all_results, "overall") |>
  mutate(
    cohort_label = format_cohort_labels(target_cohort),
    outcome_label = factor(
      format_outcome_labels(outcome),
      levels = c(
        "Ross procedure",
        "Surgical valvotomy",
        "Percutaneous valvotomy",
        "Aortic valve replacement",
        "Death"
      )
    )
  )

survival_by_strata <- process_survival_curves(all_results, "age_group") |>
  mutate(
    combined_strata = coalesce(strata_level, "Overall"),
    cohort_label = format_cohort_labels(target_cohort),
    age_group = if_else(
      grepl("&&&", combined_strata),
      trimws(sub(" &&&.*$", "", combined_strata)),
      combined_strata
    ),
    sex = if_else(
      grepl("&&&", combined_strata),
      trimws(sub("^.*&&&\\s*", "", combined_strata)),
      "All"
    ),
    age_group = factor(
      age_group,
      levels = c("0 to 1", "2 to 12", "13 to 17", "0 to 4", "5 to 9", "10 to 14", "15 to 17")
    ),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male", "All")),
    outcome_label = factor(
      format_outcome_labels(outcome),
      levels = c(
        "Ross procedure",
        "Surgical valvotomy",
        "Percutaneous valvotomy",
        "Aortic valve replacement",
        "Death"
      )
    )
  )

stratified_risk_summary <- survival_by_strata |>
  group_by(cdm_name, cohort_label, outcome_label, age_group, sex) |>
  slice_max(order_by = time, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    event_risk = pmax(0, pmin(1, 1 - survival_prob)),
    risk_label = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * event_risk)
  )

cohort_palette <- c(
  "Congenital Aortic Stenosis" = "#F8766D",
  "Congenital Aortic Valve Disease" = "#00BFC4",
  "Aortic Insufficiency" = "#7CAE00",
  "Aortic Stenosis" = "#C77CFF"
)

```

## Baseline Profile

### Baseline Age Distribution

```{r baseline-age-distribution, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if(nrow(baseline_age_distribution) > 0) {
  baseline_age_distribution |>
    ggplot(aes(x = age_group, y = n, fill = sex)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65, color = "white") +
    facet_grid(. ~ cohort_label + cdm_name) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "#FF6B9D", "Male" = "#4A90E2"), name = "Sex") +
    labs(
      x = "Age group",
      y = "Number of children",
      title = "Baseline Age Distribution",
      subtitle = paste0("Total cohort size: n = ", unique(baseline_age_distribution$total_n))
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#E0E0E0", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )
} else cat("No baseline age distribution data available.")
```

## Survival Analysis Results

### Summary Table

```{r survival-table, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Build gt table with conditional column alignment
table_col_names <- names(survival_table)
center_cols <- intersect(c("Number records", "Number events", "Median survival (95% CI)", 
                           "Restricted mean survival (95% CI)"), table_col_names)
left_cols <- intersect(c("CDM name", "Target cohort", "Outcome name"), table_col_names)

gt_table <- survival_table |> gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Survival Analysis Results") |>
  tab_style(style = cell_borders(sides = "all", color = "#D3D3D3", weight = px(1)), locations = cells_body()) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#F0F0F0"), locations = cells_column_labels()) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12), heading.align = "left")

if(length(center_cols) > 0) gt_table <- gt_table |> cols_align(align = "center", columns = all_of(center_cols))
if(length(left_cols) > 0) gt_table <- gt_table |> cols_align(align = "left", columns = all_of(left_cols))

gt_table
```

### Overall Outcome Panels

```{r survival-plots, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
survival_curves |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = survival_prob, color = cohort_label, fill = cohort_label)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_grid(outcome_label ~ cdm_name, scales = "free_x", switch = "y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cohort_palette, name = "Target cohort", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cohort_palette, name = "Target cohort", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Time in days",
    y = "Survival probability",
    title = "Overall Survival by Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#E0E0E0", color = NA),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", angle = 0),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 11), axis.text = element_text(size = 10))
```

## Stratified Outcomes

### Age-by-Sex Summary

```{r age-sex-summary, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
if(nrow(stratified_risk_summary) > 0) {
  stratified_risk_summary |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = age_group, fill = event_risk)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = risk_label), size = 3.2) +
    facet_grid(cohort_label + cdm_name ~ outcome_label) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#E8F1FA", high = "#0B6AA2", name = "Event risk") +
    labs(
      x = "Sex",
      y = "Age group",
      title = "Outcome Risk by Age Group and Sex"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#E0E0E0", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
} else cat("No joint age-and-sex survival data available.")
```

### Survival by Age Group Within Sex

```{r survival-by-age, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
if(nrow(survival_by_strata) > 0) {
  survival_by_strata |>
    ggplot(aes(x = time, y = survival_prob, color = age_group, fill = age_group)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), alpha = 0.12, color = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    facet_grid(outcome_label ~ sex, scales = "free_x", switch = "y") +
    labs(
      x = "Time in days",
      y = "Survival probability",
      title = "Survival by Age Group Within Sex",
      color = "Age Group",
      fill = "Age Group"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#E0E0E0", color = NA),
          strip.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", angle = 0),
          strip.placement = "outside",
          legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 11), axis.text = element_text(size = 9))
} else cat("No age-stratified survival data available.")
```
